levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الأشعري

notes: The bracketed «[و]» is the text's own editorial letter and stays in the surface.
«سئل أبو عبد الله» is passive: the asker is not named, so no asker link is added.
The Imam speaks in the words after «قال» and is the last link; «عليه السلام» is excluded.
